about: Which record fields the record-lane comparator (the houseCARL integration module's record rows) does NOT compare as authored game data, named exactly as the generated schema reference (mutagen-reference/references/*.jsonl) names them. Everything else the schema lists for a record type is compared. A field whose type is, or transitively contains, another major record is a child record and is decided by the schema, not listed here. Every name below must exist in the schema; the record-rows suite's case 1 fails on one that does not. runtimeMerged mirrors runtime-merged-data.md's table where the schema models the field: DIAL's info count (TIFC) and the story-manager nodes' child (SNAM) are not fields of the generated schema, so they cannot be listed and are not compared either way. anglesRadians names fields whose values are angles in radians, compared modulo a full turn (a patch that writes -0.61 as 5.67 has not changed the rotation).

generatedBookkeeping.about: Generated bookkeeping, not authored game data, and not compared: a worldspace's LargeReferences is the list of large references by grid cell that the editing tools generate from the placed references (ruled not compared at the 4.24 phase-1 Gate C review, 2026-10-14; session 1's scorecard left it out with the worldspace container).

integerMasksAbout: Integer fields the game reads only in part, by record type and field path, with the mask of the bytes it reads; a change outside the mask is no change in game. A cell's XCLC grid holds one byte of land flags (hide quads 1-4) and three unused bytes; Mutagen reads the four bytes as one CellGrid.Flag value (Quad1-Quad4 = 0-3, not bit flags), so its Grid.Flags carries the unused bytes too. Mutagen lags xEdit here (xEdit names the three bytes Unused).
integerEnumNamesAbout: Values of a masked integer field that Mutagen prints by its enum name instead of the number (a Grid.Flags of 0 prints as Quad1), by record type and field path: the name is read as its value before the mask applies, so one value printed two ways is one value.
recordFlagsAbout: The record header's flags, on any record type. Mutagen shows the same 32 bits twice: field (SkyrimMajorRecordFlags, base names) and sameBitsAs (MajorFlags, names that differ per record type); a record that authors both is judged once, on field. A value prints as comma-separated names from bits when every set bit has a name, else as the whole decimal number; a name not in bits is never guessed, so the row stays. Values that differ only in the storageOnly bits are no change in game: Compressed (0x40000) says how the record is stored. sameBitsAs values are read only as numbers, since their names are per type. bits are SkyrimMajorRecord.SkyrimMajorRecordFlag of Mutagen.Bethesda.Skyrim 0.54.4, read by reflection 2026-11-07.
